# PLATEAU City Viewer

> Open-source (MIT) three.js viewer for Japan's PLATEAU 3D city models: load the buildings of a real block, walk the streets, and break buildings one by one. Built by Industrial Dream Inc. (AI BunCho).

- Demo: walk and break a 400 m x 300 m block of Ginza, Tokyo (this site).
- Converter: PLATEAU 3D Tiles (b3dm, LOD1/LOD2) -> compact JSON, one mesh per building.
- Data: 「3D都市モデル（Project PLATEAU）東京都中央区（2025年度）」（国土交通省）（https://www.mlit.go.jp/plateau/open-data/）を加工して作成 (PLATEAU site policy, PDL 1.0, CC BY 4.0 compatible).

## Photoreal version (paid API)

- [BunCho City API](https://bun-cho.work/developers/city): Gaussian-splat city aligned to PLATEAU footprints and heights, plus one collision mesh per building. 300 DREAM per 400 m x 300 m block. Free price check with dry_run.
- [Agent guide](https://bun-cho.work/docs/agents/city.md)
- [BunCho API quickstart](https://bun-cho.work/docs/agents/quickstart.md)
- [All of BunCho](https://bun-cho.work/llms.txt)
